5	Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) requires identifying relations between entity pairs scattered across multiple sentences, demanding cross-sentence reasoning over long contexts. tool_args.old_string: Evidence grounding has been explored primarily through encoder architectures in DocRE. These encoder-based methods treat evidence as an auxiliary training signal rather than a generative output, limiting their ability to provide verifiable provenance at inference time.
